biggest_catch: The payout is a digital gift card, not cash, and it 'may not be redeemed for cash' - plus Salal can delay or refuse any reward for any reason under its verification rules.
catches: Referrer gets a $100 Visa digital gift card per valid referral; gift cards have no cash value and cannot be transferred, auctioned, traded, or sold.
Cap: $500 in rewards per year (5 referrals); max 25 referrals per session, 500 total per user over the program.
Rewards subject to verification; Salal may delay a reward for investigation or refuse to verify/process any transaction for any reason.
Referrer must be a US resident 18+; referrals must be personal (no bulk email/spam to strangers).
No self-referrals or fake accounts; employees, subsidiaries, and promotional agencies ineligible.
Members responsible for federal/state/local taxes on rewards.
Program may be cancelled, modified, or terminated at any time for any reason.
